items.text: 1.1 TRG Pakistan Limited ("the Company") was incorporated in Pakistan as a public limited company on December 2, 2002 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited. The registered office of the Company is situated at 24th Floor, Sky Tower, West Wing, Dolmen, HC-3, Block- 4, Marine Drive, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan. On May 14, 2003 the Company obtained a license from the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan ("SECP") to undertake venture capital investment as a Non-Banking Finance Company in accordance with the Non-Banking Finance Companies (Establishment and Regulation) Rules, 2003 (NBFC Rules).
